description: Machine-readable module + task map. Read by tools/ctx.py, validated by tools/verify_docs.py. Source of truth for which files to touch for a given task.

layers.L0: Bootstrap: logging, dependency preflight, Tk mainloop
layers.L1: Presentation: GUI widgets and overlays (Tk main thread only)
layers.L2: Orchestration: bot loops, state machine, threading (bot daemon thread)
layers.L3: Services: screen capture and OCR/parsing (pure services, no GUI)

entrypoint.role: Application bootstrap: logging setup, dependency preflight, create MainWindow, run Tk mainloop.
rules: Do not import core modules directly here; MainWindow owns that wiring.
sys.path insertion of the repo root is required for the src package to resolve.

gui-main-window.role: CustomTkinter window: mode selector, target/timing entries, coordinate buttons, control buttons, status labels, log textbox.
rules: Tk widgets may only be touched on the Tk main thread; bot callbacks arrive on the bot thread.
Bot lifecycle (start/pause/stop) must go through BotBase public methods.
Never keep configuration only in widgets: every change must reach config_manager.

gui-coordinate-picker.role: Fullscreen transparent overlay to pick a point (fuse button) or a rectangle (log ROI) using event.x_root/event.y_root.
rules: Coordinates must be absolute screen pixels (x_root/y_root), never widget-relative.
RegionSelector enforces a 10x10 px minimum size.
Keep this module dependency-free: no core imports allowed.

core-bot-base.role: BotBase ABC: daemon thread lifecycle, cooperative pause/stop, BotStatus/BotState/StopReason, Win32 click, SRO_Client foreground activation, winsound alarms.
rules: Subclasses must implement _run_loop and _perform_iteration.
Every loop iteration must call _check_pause_stop() first and bail out when it returns True.
Status changes must go through _update_status so callbacks fire.
This module owns all Win32 primitives; there is no input_controller module.

core-bot-plus.role: PlusModeBot: click fuse, wait for the animation, OCR the log, stop when the current plus level is at or above target.
rules: configure() must be called before start(): _animation_delay/_click_delay/_max_failures are only set there.
The loop ends on target reached (COMPLETED) or consecutive failures >= _max_failures (FAILED).

core-bot-stat.role: StatModeBot: click fuse, OCR the stat/percentage line, resolve the current value from the parsed dict, track best/worst, stop at threshold.
rules: configure() must be called before start().
_extract_stat_value is the only place that reads the polymorphic ParseResult.value dict (new_avg, then new_value, else 0.0).

core-screen-capture.role: ScreenCapture singleton wrapping mss: grab a rectangle and return a BGR numpy array, plus PIL and monitor helpers.
rules: capture_region returns BGRA to BGR numpy; every consumer (cv2, OCR) expects BGR, never PIL.
Coordinates are absolute screen pixels and bounds are not validated.
The mss instance is created at import time, so importing this module requires a Windows desktop session.

core-ocr.role: OCRProcessor singleton: OpenCV preprocessing (gray/blur/Otsu/close), Tesseract extraction with a char whitelist, then strict regex parsing into ParseResult.
rules: Parser order is a contract: earlier patterns win (plus: failed, then +N, then plus N, then success+number; stat: changedto, parens, range, simple, arrow, failed).
process_log_region is the only entry point bots may call; mode must be plus or stat.
Stat results are polymorphic: dicts hold either old_value/new_value/improved or old_range/new_range/old_avg/new_avg/improved.

core-config.role: BotConfig dataclass (all persisted settings) plus the thread-safe ConfigManager singleton that loads/saves %APPDATA%/SroAutoAlchemy/config.json.
rules: New settings must be added to BotConfig with an explicit default.
update() silently drops unknown keys (hasattr guard), so a typo is invisible: verify field names.
Importing this module reads config.json from disk (import side effect).
Keep this module free of cv2/mss/pytesseract/tkinter imports.

ocr.summary: OCR preprocessing, Tesseract settings, regex patterns, parse results
verify: GUI Test OCR button with a real log line
rules: Keep the parser order intact and justify the priority of any new pattern.

gui.summary: Widgets, layout, buttons, entries, log box, mode switching
rules: Tk main thread rule: never update widgets directly inside a bot-thread callback.

verify: python main.py > Pick Fuse Button / Select Log Area
rules: Produce screen-space coordinates only (x_root/y_root).

config.summary: New settings, defaults, persistence, AppData JSON
rules: Field name equals the config.json key; do not remove old keys (backward compatibility).

bot.summary: Bot loop, plus/stat modes, stop conditions, alarm
rules: configure() before start() is mandatory.

thread.summary: Threading, locks, callbacks, UI updates from the bot thread
rules: Tk calls from the bot thread are thread-unsafe; marshal with root.after(0, ...).

window.summary: SRO_Client window detection, foreground activation, clicking, alarms
rules: Wrap Win32 calls in try/except and log the failure.

capture.summary: Screen capture, ROI, monitors, image format
rules: Return BGR numpy; converting to PIL is the consumer job.

packaging.summary: PyInstaller spec, exe build, hidden imports
rules: Any new third-party dependency must also be added to spec hiddenimports.
